preferences.heading: Language and region
preferences.language_hint: Translations are machine-generated. We'll apply your choice right away.
preferences.timezone_hint: Dates and times across Crestio use your browser's timezone.
preferences.calendar_export_body: Generate a private subscription URL for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, or any app that supports iCal feeds. Your sessions refresh automatically every hour.
preferences.url_hint: Copy this URL, then add it to your calendar app. Your sessions will appear automatically and refresh every hour.
preferences.how_add: How do I add this to my calendar?
preferences.private_warning: Keep this URL private. Anyone with it can see your tutoring schedule. Revoke if it leaks.

organisation.heading: Organisation name
organisation.name_hint: Shown to parents in emails, the parent portal, and on invoices. 1–80 characters.
organisation.name_too_long: Organisation name must be between 1 and 80 characters.

notifications.heading: Email notifications
notifications.intro: In-app notifications always appear regardless of these settings. These toggles only control email delivery.

session_reminders.label: Session reminders
session_reminders.description: Email you one hour before each scheduled session.

invoice_events.label: Invoice events
invoice_events.description: When a parent marks an invoice paid or views it.

overdue_alerts.label: Overdue invoice reminders
overdue_alerts.description: Once-per-invoice reminder 14 days after the due date.

trial_and_billing.label: Trial and billing alerts
trial_and_billing.description: Trial ending, payment failures, subscription changes.

messages_email.label: Messages from parents
messages_email.description: Emails you when a parent sends you a message, throttled to once every 30 minutes per thread.

messages_urgent_only.label: Urgent messages only
messages_urgent_only.description: If on, skip emails for normal or info messages. You still see them in-app.

account.pay_hint: Set by your organisation owner. If this looks wrong, talk to them.
account.mfa_scan_prompt: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, Authy, or 1Password, then enter the 6-digit code below to verify.
account.mfa_invalid_code: Invalid code. Check your authenticator app and try again.
account.mfa_enabled_body: You'll be asked for a 6-digit code from your authenticator app whenever you sign in.
account.mfa_disabled_body: Add an extra layer of security. When enabled, you'll need your password and a 6-digit code from your authenticator app to sign in.
account.mfa_disable_confirm: Are you sure? You will only need your password to sign in.
account.voice_privacy: Voice transcription is processed by an AI service provider. Your audio is sent only when you use the microphone, is not stored after transcription, and is never used to train models.
account.delete_body_prefix: This permanently deletes your account, all your students, sessions, invoices, and lesson plans. This cannot be undone. Type
account.owner_body: As the platform owner you have unlimited access to every feature. Toggle exemption off to temporarily experience the app as a paying customer — paywalls, trial prompts, and upgrade nudges will behave exactly as they do for real users.
account.owner_state_active: Unlimited access. No paywalls will show.
account.owner_state_off: You are subject to normal Stripe gating.
account.owner_test_accounts_body: When on, test accounts appear in the Students, Tutors, and other lists with a TEST pill. Off by default.

team.upgrade_body: Upgrade to Crestio Team to invite tutors, manage payouts, and collaborate. Up to 5 tutors for {{price}}/month.
team.heading: Team members
team.revoke_confirm: Revoke this invitation? The recipient's link will stop working.
team.invite_already_member: This person is already on your team.
team.invite_already_pending: An invitation to this email is still pending.
team.invite_email_failed: Invitation created, but email delivery failed. Copy the link from the pending list and send it manually.

billing.toast_cancelled: Checkout was cancelled. Your card was not charged.
billing.headline_past_due: Payment past due — update your card to keep access
billing.checkout_error: Could not start checkout. Please try again.
billing.portal_error: Could not open the billing portal. Please try again.
billing.upgrade_team_note: Add tutors, manage payouts, invite your team.
billing.downgrade_solo_note: Applies at the end of your current billing cycle.
billing.gst_note: Payments handled by Stripe. All prices in Australian Dollars, inclusive of GST where applicable.

referrals_page.message_template: Hey — I've been using Crestio to manage my tutoring. It's actually good. Here's 25% off your first month if you want to try: {{link}}

share.heading: Share Crestio. Get 25% off each month you refer a friend.
share.body: When a friend signs up using your code and their trial converts, you both get 25% off your next month.

history.heading: Conversion history
history.usage_line: You've used <bold>{{used}}</bold> of <bold>{{max}}</bold> referrals this year.
history.at_cap: You've hit this year's referral cap. New referrals still get their 25% discount, but you won't earn more credits until the cap resets in January.
history.empty: No referrals yet. Share your link above to get started.

credits.heading: Credit balance
credits.footnote: Applies automatically to your next invoice. Credits expire 90 days after issue.
